What the client wants to know: How many participants are registered in each location?
Logic (plain words): Count every registered participant (not deleted), grouped by the location (City) of their address.
Click-through shows: List of participants in that location: name, gender, location, registration date

What the client wants to know: How many participants did we register each month?
Logic (plain words): Count participants by the month of their registration date, split by gender. Months with no registrations must show 0.
Visualisation: Bar chart by month, stacked by gender
Click-through shows: Participants registered in the clicked month

What the client wants to know: What is the age profile of our participants?
Logic (plain words): Age today from date of birth. Groups: Under 18, 18–25, 26–35, 36–50, 51 and above, Unknown.
Click-through shows: Participants in the clicked age group

What the client wants to know: What education levels do our participants have?
Logic (plain words): Count participants by Education. Show blanks as 'Not collected yet' (do not drop them).
Click-through shows: Participants with the clicked education level

What the client wants to know: How many cohorts are On-Going, Completed or Dropped?
Logic (plain words): Count cohorts (not deleted) by Cohort Status, and by Community Type.
Click-through shows: List of cohorts with that status

What the client wants to know: How many sessions were conducted each month, by type of engagement?
Logic (plain words): Conducted = session has a date and was not cancelled. Engagement Type comes from the cohort. Months with none show 0.
Visualisation: Bar chart by month, stacked by Engagement Type
Click-through shows: Sessions in the clicked month: cohort, date, topic(s), facilitator(s)

What the client wants to know: Which topics have we covered, and how often?
Logic (plain words): Count conducted sessions per topic. A session can cover several topics and counts once under each.
Click-through shows: Sessions that covered the clicked topic

What the client wants to know: How many sessions has each facilitator conducted?
Logic (plain words): Count conducted sessions per facilitator. A session can have more than one facilitator; count it for each.

What the client wants to know: How long are our sessions on average?
Logic (plain words): Average of Session Duration in minutes, by Engagement Type. Duration is recorded like 'PT1H30M' (1 h 30 min).
Visualisation: Table: engagement type, sessions, average minutes
Click-through shows: Sessions with their duration in minutes

What the client wants to know: How many different people has each donor's work reached?
Logic (plain words): Distinct participants in cohorts funded by each donor. A person in two cohorts of the same donor counts once.
Click-through shows: Participants reached by the clicked donor

What the client wants to know: Which on-going cohorts have not met in the last 30 days?
Logic (plain words): On-Going cohorts with no conducted session in the last 30 days. Show last session date and days since.

What the client wants to know: Where are cohort submissions in the approval process?
Logic (plain words): For each cohort, take its LATEST 'Submission for approval'. Count cohorts by status: Approved, Pending, Rejected, Not submitted.

What the client wants to know: How many participants got a job after the program?
Logic (plain words): Count of participants employed after completing the program.
